# Node.js Chimera II integration

Node.js ESM is the web/integration companion to the native Chimera II implementation. It consumes the same deterministic crypto/AI vectors and JSON/JSONL interoperability contracts used by Python, Java and C++. It exposes integration boundaries for C8192/R8192 telemetry, public blockchain observation and audit metadata.

The Node layer does not replace Koronos, Spit Fire, Jasper, Spotnik or native drivers and does not implement private-key cracking or address-targeted recovery.
